weakened_contact_counterexample.scope: Refutes a derivative-quotient-only contact assertion; violates the required zero-fiber condition and is not an SFC counterexample.

degree_obstruction_controls.scope: Finite arithmetic controls only; the degree obstruction and descent converse have separate general written proofs.
